the TAM is not suitable for the explanation of acceptance of software systems in the enterprise context.
a qualitative approach is useful for theory development.

the development and testing of a new model of acceptance.
the development of a new theory of acceptance and the development of new constructs of acceptance.
a qualitative research approach for the development of new constructs in technology acceptance.

the quantitative approach is not suitable to develop and test new constructs.
the qualitative approach is an appropriate approach to examine technology acceptance.
the quantitative approach is not sufficient for theory-development and that the qualitative approach can contribute to the acceptance-research.

the TAM is not able to describe the acceptance of new software systems.
a qualitative approach can help us to find out new constructs for acceptance research.
a qualitative approach can lead to new insights for the field of technology acceptance.

qualitative approaches can be used to build up a new theory.
